title: task complete on a record already at the terminal status should relocate it, not error Illegal task transition
description:
Reported by lore-cli (2026-09-18, cross-session message): a specialist ran `quest task edit --status "Done"` instead of `quest task complete`. Per QCLI-221 (Done), that is intentional and correct -- status and on-disk location are deliberately independent, and `task edit --status <terminal>` legitimately leaves the record in tasks/. QCLI-221 also already decided `quest doctor` should NOT flag a Done record sitting outside completed/, since that would be a false positive against this exact design. Neither of those decisions is being reopened here.

The real gap is narrower: once a record is at the terminal status but still stored in tasks/, there is no direct command to finish the tasks/ -> completed/ relocation if someone wants it. `quest task complete <id>` fails with `Illegal task transition: Done -> Done`, because the transform used by TaskService.complete() (src/application/tasks/tasks.ts) unconditionally calls transitionTask(task, terminal, policy) before moveTask ever reaches its own already-at-destination check -- so the transitionTask ladder check (position+1) throws first, for any task already sitting at the terminal status, regardless of storage location. (Note: `task archive` does not have this problem -- archive() has no transform and moves any record regardless of status.)

lore-cli worked around it with `quest task demote <id> --to "In Progress"` then `quest task complete <id>`, which works but is a non-obvious two-command dance for something that reads like it should be one command.

acceptanceCriteria.text: quest task complete <id> succeeds and relocates the record to .quest/completed/ when its status is already the terminal status but it is still stored in tasks/, instead of erroring Illegal task transition: <status> -> <status>
The fix is scoped to complete; task edit --status <terminal> continues to not relocate, per QCLI-221, which this task does not reopen

Whether finalSummary/unresolvedAtCompletion are (re)computed on this no-op-status completion path is a documented decision on this task, reconciled with QCLI-336's computed-once-at-real-completion model for a record that never actually went through complete() before

Tests cover: completing a task that reached the terminal status via edit while still in tasks/ (the exact shape lore-cli hit) without needing the demote-then-complete workaround, and that completing a record already located at completed/ still errors exactly as it does today
quest help task complete documents the no-op-status relocation behavior

plan: Fix complete() to skip the status transition when the record is already at the terminal status, so it relocates rather than erroring
Record the AC3 decision (opum-doc DEC-172 (4ai) A) on the branch with the code
Tests: the exact lore-cli shape relocating in one command, and the computed fields present after the relocate-completion
Document the no-op-status relocation in quest help task complete
run bun run check, review, land
implementationNotes:
AC3 DECISION, opum-doc ruling DEC-172 (4ai), option A. The ruling, VERBATIM:

"complete() COMPUTES finalSummary-derived fields and unresolvedAtCompletion on this path too. The rule is 'complete() computes them', whatever status the record already had. A record set to Done by `edit --status` never went through the completion ceremony, so this first pass through complete() IS its real completion under QCLI-336's model. It's also consistent with QCLI-479: completion writes the current values. One Done shape, not two."

IMPLEMENTED ACCORDINGLY. complete() now skips ONLY the status transition when the record is already at the terminal status, and runs everything after it unchanged -- so --final-summary is still applied and unresolvedAtCompletion is still computed on this relocate path. The test asserts BOTH fields are present after the relocate-completion (AC4). Consistent with QCLI-479 (completion rewrites the current values) and QCLI-336 (a first pass through complete() is the real completion).

REVIEW ROUND 1 FIX (changes-requested, major). AC3 second clause requires that completing a record ALREADY located at completed/ still errors exactly as it does today, and my first cut BROKE that: skipping the transition for any already-terminal record let moveTask own already-at-destination token fire instead of transitionTask Illegal task transition refusal. Fixed by giving the moveTask transform the record own location and skipping the status transition ONLY when the record is not already at the destination (location !== completed). Measured after the fix: complete on a Done record in tasks/ exits 0 and relocates; a SECOND complete on the same now-completed record exits 6 with Illegal task transition: Done -> Done, byte-identical to before. A test now pins that second clause, and the task complete help is qualified (a record already in .quest/completed/ still refuses).
finalSummary: QCLI-338: task complete now relocates a record already at the terminal status rather than erroring Illegal task transition: Done -> Done. complete() skips ONLY the status transition when the record is already terminal and runs the rest unchanged, so --final-summary and unresolvedAtCompletion are computed on that path too -- opum-doc DEC-172 (4ai) A, recorded verbatim on the task as AC3 decision. Scoped to complete: task edit --status <terminal> still does not relocate (AC2); quest help task complete documents it (AC5). Tests cover the exact lore-cli shape in one command and both computed fields after the relocate-completion. bun run check exits 0. Delivered on branch qcli-338-complete-relocate, record in the same PR.
